# Phase 7 — Connect Progression UI Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace all mock and placeholder progression, PR, and chart data in the Exercise Detail tab of the Progress page with real data generated by the Phase 6 deterministic progression engine.

**Architecture:** `ExerciseDetailView` will process the user's authenticated `ExerciseHistory` (loaded via Server Action `getExerciseWorkoutHistory`) through Phase 6 pure deterministic functions (`deriveWorkoutFacts`, `derivePersonalRecords`, and `classifyProgression`). Mock progression reads and legacy mock ID mapping (`LEGACY_PROGRESS_ID_BY_BUILT_IN_ID`) will be removed, while layout, design tokens, and components (`RuneBadge`, `RunePanel`, Recharts `AreaChart`, `EmptyState`) remain unchanged.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router / Server Actions), React 19, TypeScript 5.9, Recharts, Vitest, Testing Library.

## Global Constraints

- **Strict User Isolation:** Derive exercise history and progression server-side for the authenticated user.
- **Phase 6 Contract Compliance:** Reuse `deriveWorkoutFacts`, `derivePersonalRecords`, and `classifyProgression` without modifying their formulas, classification rules, or precedence.
- **UI & Layout Preservation:** Do not redesign screens or add new features; retain incumbent Norse charcoal/bone/moss visual hierarchy.
- **Mock Cleanup:** Remove mock progression data imports from connected UI components without affecting un-migrated tabs (e.g. AnalyticsView in Phase 9).
- **Quality Standards:** All tests, typechecks, lints, and production builds must pass without regression.
